title: The canal wharves (汴河 · 运河两岸): the luxury passenger boat, the trackers, the boat rowed upstream by eight men, the riverside eateries, 王家纸马铺, the deep-laden grain boats and the porters carrying grain ashore, the 望楼饭铺 sheds and the 望火楼 (余辉 seg. 2; reference/scroll/sections.md S2; area u 20500-29050, looking 150 px past both ends)
note: The S2 area's whole rect, for the record only. Don't run the pipeline on `canal`: the image API letterboxes a 4.9:1 overview (asked 4096x832, got 4096x1658 with white bands), which ruins every tile's overview crop. The restyle runs as two halves, `canal/west` and `canal/east` (sections/canal/west|east/section.json); the broken whole run is kept in gen/sections/canal/runs/whole_letterboxed/.
